technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot Test framework for integration testing with mock buses to avoid external dependencies.
Implement a custom test binder that simulates message bus functionality for module wiring and configuration testing.
Leverage Hadoop YARN APIs for distributed deployment investigation and SPI strategy design.
Use Spring Data Redis and Spring Cloud Connectors for Redis/Sentinel cluster support.
Follow Spring Boot auto-configuration patterns using @ConditionalOnClass and @ConfigurationProperties for singlenode binder.
Ensure backward compatibility and incremental upgrades when updating receptor-client API.
Integrate admin UI client using REST client or Spring MVC controllers for server communication.
Design parameter passing for YARN containers using application configuration and environment variables.
assumptions: The developer has access to the Spring Cloud Stream and related project codebases, including existing modules and dependencies.
Development is done in Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0, with standard build tools like Maven or Gradle.
External infrastructure (e.g., YARN clusters, Redis servers) is not required for development; testing uses mocks or embedded servers.
All user stories are treated as equally prioritized and must be delivered in this increment.
Effort estimates are for a single developer experienced in Spring ecosystem and enterprise Java development.
Existing code is well-structured and modular, allowing for straightforward migration and upgrades.
No major architectural changes are needed; work involves adding features and integrations to existing code.
Testing and documentation are integral parts of development and included in the estimates.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement integration testing framework, including test binder for mock bus simulation and idiomatic assertions using Hamcrest or similar.
Investigate distributed deployment of modules on YARN, analyze YARN SPI requirements, and design the strategy for YARNModuleDeployer.
Migrate the trigger module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repository, adapt code for compatibility, and ensure functionality as a source for streaming pipelines.
Add support for Redis/Sentinel cluster as a message bus, including configuration, connection management, and integration with Spring Cloud Stream.
Upgrade receptor-client to comply with latest Receptor API changes, update dependencies, and ensure sync with recent improvements.
Integrate existing admin UI client for spring-cloud-data admin, configure server endpoints, and handle communication for user management.
Create auto-configuration for singlenode binder configuration and properties, using Spring Boot conventions for automatic setup based on dependencies.
Implement support for passing definition parameters into YARN containers, enabling effective use of parameters within modules running inside containers.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and bug fixing for all implemented features, ensuring reliability and compliance with requirements.
Write documentation for new features, refactor code for maintainability, and perform code reviews to ensure quality.
